title: Tessaly Foods: board KPI pack, third quarter

cover.title: Tessaly Foods: quarter three operating review
cover.sub: Results against budget, the variance and its owners, and two decisions for the board.
cover.meta: As of 30 Sep · fictional company · theme specimen

exec.title: Revenue missed budget by {miss}, but margin and cash held and leverage fell again

rows.p: Two retail contracts started a quarter late; pricing held, so margin stayed ahead of budget even on lower sales.
Working capital released on the late contracts lifted cash conversion, and leverage fell for the fourth quarter running.
The chilled pricing reset and the contract recovery plan, each with a named owner and a monthly checkpoint.

exec.source: Source: Tessaly Foods management accounts (fictional), unaudited

chart.title: Two delayed contracts explain {share} of the quarter's {miss2} revenue shortfall to budget

exhibit.title: Revenue shortfall to budget by cause, third quarter

bullets: Both delayed contracts are now live and shipping weekly.
Price and mix recover with the chilled reset in the next quarter.
Promotion timing reverses in the fourth quarter on the agreed calendar.
takeaway.sowhat: The commercial director owns {cd} of the gap, and most of it returns next quarter.
